oneLine.description: what you think this does, in at most 15 words

leaves.description: each asset that leaves your wallet: amount (or 'up to'), asset, to whom

arrives.description: each asset you get: amount (or 'at least'), asset, from whom

permissions.description: each permission you give: who can do what with what

other.description: anything else that changes for you (a position, a setting, an owner)

unsure.description: what you can't tell from the screen
